notes.title: Demo Update v21a - Patch Notes
notes.content:
We just pushed a new update to the Demo!



Major

Revamped Camera controls - you can now always use keyboard/joystick to move around and only need to hold RMB to look around

Build Menu Camera now behaves the same as regular camera

Decreased build area around Castle on Skirmish Maps

Units will clear their bodies after 4 rounds now

Ranged enemies can now attack your castle by shooting arrow/fire/marbles at it

Other

Adjusted aiming reticles to be slightly more precise

Dog has slightly lower movement range now

Adjusted some enemy values like weights and attack for better balancing     

You can no longer unpossess a unit if you're jumping

Bugs

Blocks no longer count towards capturing points in Skirmish

Fixed Mug clipping the desk in background

Fixed an issue where hitting your own units on first turn would behave weirdly

Fixed a bug when unpossessing unit might not reset movement on it



Hope you like these changes and let us know in the forums if anything feels worse :)

notes.title: Demo Update v19a - Patch Notes
notes.content:
BIG thanks to everyone posting feedback in the Steam Forums or on Our Discord! 

I've been dealing with some Life Events™ and just getting back to normal schedule. Finally had time to push a patch with a bunch of improvements!





Added Volume sliders directly to Main Menu

Added Sensitivity sliders in Pause Menu (separate for looking and moving)

Adjusted first two waves on the Demo level and removed hard map edges

Added Wave counter on top right corner of the screen (i.e. "Wave 3 / 5" )

Adjusted camera when controlling Archer and Mage to make aiming down easier

Made Houses lighter so they can't block units in as easily

Adjusted Knight attack to (hopefully) fix an issue with it behaving inconsistently

Added spin to Marbles when they're launched

Increased Knight price by 1

Improved Aiming Dots to behave more consistently

Achievements for killing enemies should now count enemies that accidentally kill themselves (otherwise it was difficult to get the last one)

Fixed houses producing gold when knocked over

Fixed enemy units occasionally killing themselves by moving around





Enjoy!



- Jakub (Lead Dev)
